buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 4. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 5. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 6. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 7. Service & Support The Service Provider must own 30% of the bid quantity of vehicles in Service Provider’s name or in the name of the proprietor / partner of the Service Provider. Necessary documents relating to proof of ownership will be uploaded by the bidder for verification of the buyer. Such Service Provider owned vehicles will be part of the fleet to be deployed by the Service Provider in case he gets the contract against this bid. 8. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 9. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to

staff. 10. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc.Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 11. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Scope of Work 1. Eligibility Criteria:- Security Guard for Ward & Watch (without Arms): - a. Security Guards should wear the uniform, while on duty, prescribed by the Security Agency and f ulfill such physical standards as may be prescribed. b. Security Guards should have undergone proper training on all security related issues, should be decent and well behaved. c. Once the guard has been allotted a spot/site, he/she shall remain in the same position till he/she is shifted. d. The antecedents should have been verified by the First Party (hereinafter referred to as ‘Securit y Agency’) from the local police authorities and the Security Agency has to certify the good moral character of each person. A report in this regard, after due verification, must be submit in the records of the HoD or the DDO co ncerned. Contactor/MSP would be responsible for Background check of all the contractual staff that is bein g deployed in the Department through the contractor/MSP. The Background check of the staff would include: a) Identity b) Address c) Criminal Records d) Employment History/ Experience e) ADHAAR f) Education g) Reference from 02 credible persons Background check report of the contractual staffs. 2. Eligibility Criteria:- The Security agency should have head office in Etawah, Agra, Mainpuri or Firozabad. The supportive docu ments like address proof is required to be produced during technical evaluation. a) The entire work included in the contract shall be executed by the Security Agency and shall not, directly or indirectly, be transferred, assigned or sublet or any part shared nor shall they take a new

associate without the written consent of O/o Income tax Officer (Admin) Etawah at Etawah. Any lapse in th is regard will lead to the termination of contract. b) A Security Guard deployed for any shift on a particular day shall not be placed on duty on any o ther shift on the same day by the Security Agency. If it is found that the same Security Guard is deployed f or more shift(s) on the same day, it will be deemed that no Security Guard has been deployed and also a p enalty of Rs.500/- will be levied for each such default. The penalty amounts shall double at the end of ever y three such defaults. c) The Security Agency shall provide uniform along with photo identity card to Security Guard at it s own cost and should ensure that the staff is on duty at all times in neat and clean uniform. A penalty of R s. 200/- per day per Security Guard shall be deducted for non-wearing of uniform. The penalty amount shal l double at the end of every three such defaults. d) The security guard should always have a first Aid Box and should be able to use it. e) The Security Agency should have minimum three years’ experience in providing Security Guard s to reputed organizations/Public and Government institutions. Preference will be given to Security Agency who has more experience in providing Security Guards to Income Tax office premises. It is mandatory to u pload experience certificate during the bidding process. f) The Security Agency shall submit certified financial statements and IT returns of the three A.Y. 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26. g) The Security Agency shall obtain a valid Private Security Agencies Regulation Act license issued by State Controlling Authority of Uttar Pradesh, labour license under the Contract Labour (R&A) Act 1970 t he Contract Labour (R&A) Central Rules 1971, Payment of Wages Act 1936, Minimum Wages Act 1948, The shops and establishment Act, The Employees Provident Fund & Miscellaneous Provisions Act/ The Employe es state Insurance Act, Employees Liability Act 1938, Workmen’s. h) Commercial electricity bill in the name of the bidder/ proprietorship firm/ its proprietor (in case o f proprietorship concern). i) Commercial property ownership/ Rent Agreement in the name of bidder/ proprietorship firm/ its proprietor (in case of proprietorship concern), duly registered with sub registrar. j) Registration with Labour Department showing the address within Uttar Pradesh. k) TAN no. issued by I.T. Department having address within Uttar Pradesh. l) GSTIN having address within Uttar Pradesh. m) Registration issued by registrar of firms and societies having address within Uttar Pradesh.

i) Compensation Act 1923, Industrial Dispute Act 1947; orders, notifications, etc., present or futur e applicable to Security Agency from time to time for providing Security. j) The wages payable for the work of the Security Guards deployed by the Security Agency to Inc ome-tax Office, Etawah shall be as per the guidelines of the Central Government on this matter. k) The Security Agency shall be responsible to provide immediate replacement for any security g uard/personnel who are not available for duty at the place of posting. l) The Security Agency shall indemnify Office of O/o Income tax Officer (Admin) Etawah at Etawah against payments to be made under and for the non-observance of the laws/regulations (if any) in this reg ard. m) The Security Agency should furnish the name, qualification, proof of identity and effective verific ation of investigation into the background, antecedents, past conduct and character of each person the Se curity Agency proposes to deploy. The Security Agency and/or its staff shall neither use nor spend any par t of their duty hour on recreational or entertainment activities. n) The Security Agency will ensure that their staffs employed do not loiter in the corridors, chit cha t, mobile chatting, chew pans or smoking etc. A penalty of Rs. 500/- will be imposed for each incidence of breach of this clause. The penalty amount shall double at the end of every three such defaults. o) The Security guards/other staffs of the Security Agency should leave the campus of this office i mmediately after completion of their job on the campus. They should not be found on the campus (of this office) loitering or otherwise. p) A performance guarantee deposit of 3% of the contract value is admissible on successful bidd er. 3. LABOUR REGULATIONS The Security Agency shall at his own cost comply with the provision of labour laws, Rules, orders an d notifications whether Central or State or local as applicable to him or to this contract from time to time. These Acts/Rules include without limitation to the followings: The Central Minimum Wages Act/ The Workmen’s Compensation Act/The payment of Gratuit y Act/ The Shops and Establishment Act/The Payment of Bonus Act/The Employees Provident Fund & Miscellaneous Provisions Act/The Employees State Insurance Act/ All other Acts/Aules/Bye-laws; o rders notifications, etc., present or future applicable to the Security Agency from time to time for pe rforming the contract job. The Security Agency shall pay wages as per the prevailing wages prescribed by the Central Govern ment Minimum wages Act. The Security Agency shall maintain proper records under minimum wage s Law/Acts. Any statuary enhancement in wages by notification shall be claimed from the Departme nt by the Security Agency by furnishing documentary proof and get the rate approved by the Depar tment for payment to its employees. The Security Agency is fully responsible to observe the above laws as amended from time totime in regard to his employees and compensation and other benefits/risks in relation to employees to be e ngaged by him. The Security Agency shall have a valid license obtained from Licensing Authority under the Contract labour (Regulation & Abolition) Act, 1970.

The Security Agency shall maintain all records/registers required to be maintained by him under va rious labour laws mentioned above and produce the same before the Statutory Authorities when req uired. These shall among other things include the following: i. Muster Roll ii. Register of Wages iii. Register of Deductions iv. Register of Fines v. Wage Slip vi. Register of Advances The Security Agency shall submit the EPF code number obtained from the authorities concerned un der the Employees provident Fund and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952. Insurance Cover protecting the agency against all claims applicable under Workmen’sCompensation Act, 1948 shall be taken by the Security Agency. The Security Agency shall arrange necessary Insur ance cover for any persons deployed by it even for short duration. This office shall not entertain any claim arising out of mishap, if any that may take place. In the event of any liability/ claim falling on t his office, same shall be reimbursed/ indemnified by the Security Agency. The Security Agency shall also submit periodical reports/returns to the various statutory authorities such as the Contract labour (Regulation & Abolition) Act, 1970, Employees Provident Fund Act, etc. The Security Guard/staff/personnel engaged by the Security Agency shall be exclusively the employ ees of the Security Agency and it shall be the duty of the Security Agency to pay their monthly salar y and necessary statutory compliance as required by various laws in force. There shall be no emplo yer- employee relationship between the Security Guard/staff/personnel deployed by the Security Ag ency for the work covered by this tender and this office or Income Tax Department. Under any circu mstances, the said Security Guard/staff/personnel shall not claim any absorption/compensation/reg ularization in this office or Income Tax Department. The Security Agency shall ensure that this point is clearly laid out in the terms of agreement that the Security Agency shall be entering with the Sec urity Guard/staff/personnel. If any of the persons engaged by the Security Agency misbehaves with any of the officials of the Income T ax Office, Etawah, or any tax payers/public visiting the Income Tax Office Etawah or commits any miscon duct with regard to the property of the Income Tax Office, Income Tax Colony, Etawah, the Security Agen cy shall replace them immediately. In case office O/o Income tax Officer (Admin) Etawah feels that the co nduct of any of Security Agency’s employees is detrimental to the interests of this office/ Department, the n this office or Income Tax Office, Income Tax Colony, Etawah shall have the unqualified right to request for the removal of such employee either for incompetence, unreliability, misbehavior, security reasons, et c., while on or off the job. The Security Agency shall comply with any such request to remove such personnel at Secur ity Agency’s expense unconditionally. The Security Agency will be allowed a maximum of FIVE worki ng days to replace the person by competent qualified person at Security Agency’s cost.

The Security Agency shall not be permitted sub-contract any of the services. The Security guards will do duty in rotation of 8 hours thrice shifts in a day. Extension of agreement: The contract/agreement is extendable for 1 (one) more year, i.e., up to 31. 01.2026, at the sole discretion of Purchaser subject to policy guidelines of the Department and satisfactory performance of the Service Provider and, if required, with such amendments/modificati ons of terms and conditions as may be mutually agreed to including rise in wages/service charges t aking into account the increase in minimum wages by the Government of India after the contract comes into forc e. In order to be included in the bidding process, the bidder will have to agree with the above said c onditions and upload an undertaking. TECHNICAL BID FOR HIRING OF SECURITY GUARDS 1. Name, address and telephone Number of the Bidder i.e. the Applicant Contractor 2. Permanent Account No. (PAN) 3. Whether sufficient number of guards in eac h category is available with the Applicant Co ntractor (Furnish Documentary evidence) 4. Annual Turnover during F.Y. 2023-24, 2024- 25 & 2025-26 (Furnish Copy of Return of Inc ome along with Audit Report as obtained u/s 44AB of the I.T. Act) 5. List of reputed Clients (along with document ary evidence) (In case the given space is insufficient, please append separate sheet) 6. Date of Establishment/Incorporation of the Security Agency 7 Copy of License for operating the Security Age ncy. 8. Details of Demand Draft/Banker’s Cheque in r espect of Earnest Money (Demand draft / Banker’s cheque should be e nclosed)
